message: symbol V_name appears V_count times in V_namespace: V_places
why: Each of the four namespaces (type / workflow / backend / tool) must hold unique names. With duplicates, export lookup becomes order-dependent — the linker resolves whichever it scans first, so the same archive can link differently on two machines.
fix: or drop the duplicate export if it is a leftover
